_thisFileIsOptional: Every field below has a working default, and the app starts with no config file at all — copy this to harness.config.json only to change something. See src/server/config.ts for the defaults: the vault goes in ~/Documents/Loreweaver, the student id is your OS username, and the Loreweaver MCP server is found automatically (installed dependency, then a sibling checkout, or LOREWEAVER_ENTRY).
_modelRoutes: models.*.model supports three prefixes, mixable per role: a plain id (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5") routes through the Anthropic API and needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — the app will ask for one on first run and save it outside the vault; "ollama:<model>" routes to a local Ollama model; "claude-sdk:<model>" (e.g. "claude-sdk:sonnet") routes through the Agent SDK, drawing from your Claude Pro/Max subscription via your local `claude` CLI login (no API key, but you must be logged in on this machine) — including the tutor role (T43), which streams via SDK session resume instead of the ai-sdk agent loop. See README 'Model routes' for the full writeup and current limitations.
_search: Only needed for an ollama: tutor. An Anthropic-routed tutor researches via Anthropic's server-side web search with nothing to install.
